Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：在古代，古代 is already a time expression, so adding 时候 is redundant; use 在 to introduce the historical time setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，use 人们 for a concrete group of people; 人 is a generic noun and does not refer naturally to the people in this event.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 告诉人：告诉人们，use 人们 when referring to the group receiving Shennong’s information.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么是危险的，an adjective used after 是 to describe a thing normally takes 的 in this pattern.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：有一个叫神农的人，follow the first-mention rule: introduce a new character with a full noun phrase before using only the name in the story.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们能吃：能吃，use the zero form for the already established group in this general statement; the pronoun is unnecessary after 人们.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 试一试很多种植物：试了很多种植物，use 了 for the completed past action of trying many kinds of plants; the last verb in this action sequence takes 了.

items.reason: “古代时候” is an incorrect redundant time expression under the teacher's standard, and “在古代” is correct.
This refers to the concrete people in the story, so the teacher requires “人们” rather than generic “人”.
The people receiving the information are a concrete group, for which the teacher requires “人们”.
The predicative adjectives need “的” here: “是安全的” and “是危险的”.
神农 is first introduced here, so the teacher's reference rule requires a fuller introduction such as “有一个叫神农的人”.
Within the same clause after “人们”, repeating the referent as “他们” is unnecessary under the teacher's zero-reference rule.
The completed narrative action needs perfective “了”, and “试了很多种植物” is correct.
